statement: For a frozen candidate universe U and observed positive reference R+, if source authority does not certify R+ exhaustive over U, then every x in U minus R+ is compatible with both GLUE and OBSTRUCTION. Absence alone cannot identify OBSTRUCTION or license a point-valued harm score.

proof_witness.world_glue: x is a true equivalence omitted by a non-exhaustive positive reference
proof_witness.observational_equivalence: both worlds expose the same U and R+
proof_witness.conclusion: binary truth at x is not identified; the identified set is {GLUE,OBSTRUCTION}

v3_audit.interpretation: V3 obstruction truth was constructed by within-domain reference absence after explicit equivalence and non-binary cells were removed. The receipt does not itself certify source-level exhaustivity.

v3_immutability: V3 terminal and artifacts remain unchanged; V3 harm is typed as conditional on its retained closed-world construction.

binary_scorable_requires_one_of: authoritative explicit negative or disjointness truth
authoritative exhaustivity certificate over an immutable frozen candidate universe

wider_scope: Any discovery-style benchmark without certified exhaustive negatives supports set-valued identification for unlabelled candidates, not unconditional point-valued evaluation.
boundary: The theorem does not decide whether a particular new family is exhaustive; metadata and rights must establish that prospectively. Protected evidence, P3 coordinate claims, and population transport remain CANNOT_CHECK.
